text: Artificial intelligence is changing our world rapidly, but it also brings serious ethical challenges. One major concern is bias, because AI systems learn from data that may contain unfair patterns, leading to discriminatory decisions in areas like hiring or lending. Fairness requires us to check these systems carefully and correct any imbalances. Privacy is another key issue, as AI often relies on large amounts of personal data, which must be protected and used responsibly. Transparency is equally important—people should understand how AI makes choices, especially when those choices affect their lives. Finally, responsible AI development means involving diverse teams, testing thoroughly, and putting human values at the center of every step. Only then can we build technology that truly serves everyone.
